name: custom-wordlists
description: Build custom word lists for skribbl.io and similar word games.

scripts.build: npm run build:index && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.dump: node scripts/geography/dump-plate-data.mjs && node scripts/geography/dump-language-names.mjs && node scripts/geography/dump-country-data.mjs
scripts.build:data: node scripts/geography/build-continents.mjs --write && node scripts/geography/build-languages.mjs --write && node scripts/geography/build-country-data.mjs --write
